message:
The fuzzer calls `p2p_scan_res_handler` with the input data as IEs. This will parse the IEs and call `p2p_add_device` which will process the P2P Group Info attribute. Let me look at `p2p_scan_res_handler`:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜=command>grep -n "p2p_scan_res_handler" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/hostap/src/p2p/p2p.c | head -5</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
